def center (S : Schedule) {m N : ℕ} (p : ℕ) (h : m ≤ N) (o : Site (S.side N p)) : Tiling (S.side N p) where
  period := S.side m p
  units := S.toDepth h p
  widthHalf := half S m p
  even := original S m p
  kind := .link
  base := fun i => o i - (((S.toDepth h p).count.val/2 : ℕ) : Per (S.side N p))
